artifact.create.decision_rationale: CP-05 owns dependency-aware scheduling and dispatch; CP-07 is the required independent evidence reviewer.

artifact.verify.decision_rationale: CP-07 owns independent target verification; CP-05 supplies execution ordering and trace context.

test.recovery_path.decision_rationale: CP-05 owns bounded retry/recovery; CP-07 independently verifies the eventual target.

plugin.forensic_audit.decision_rationale: SKILL ANALYZER owns general analytical methods; A.S.F.R.E.E is the technical forensic specialist when source anatomy is required.

plugin.engineering_method.decision_rationale: Ponytail owns minimal-complete software engineering method and its evidence dossier; SDO retains source-write lifecycle ownership and Evaluator Team supplies independent quality judgement. The route is selected declaratively, but dispatch remains blocked until a verified plugin-skill host adapter is configured.

plugin.skill_analyzer_p0_pilot.decision_rationale: P0 is deliberately one canonical skill and one verified Codex CLI host adapter. SKILL ANALYZER owns its own analytical method; no additional specialist is added to this first vertical slice.
